claims.title: Use one nominal controller and encoder for an explicitly stationary unknown-error class

quoted_fields.interface: The acquired substantive root review accepts one fixed strictly local nominal controller, shared decoder and nominal thermal encoder, selected before unknown energy-neutral coherent errors and explicitly nominal-Gibbs-balanced dissipative errors. The full logical/reference channel has diamond error<=8 Jstar n p_Q time, linear in supportwise rare-bad probability, over a stretched-exponential size interval. Exact charged-error admission obstructions and a finite-bit initializer are separately included.
quoted_fields.failure: Actual stationary state is rho0=Gibbs(H0), generally NOT Gibbs(H0+V). Unknown Hermitian V must satisfy[H0,V]=0; it may fail individual-check commutation. Dissipative errors must be the declared balanced class, not all weak Lindblad errors. Arbitrary energy-changing errors, native physical controller/bath, useful thresholds, efficient/noisy initialization and advantage remain open. The ordinary Bravyi-Terhal trace receiver and nominal Davies/virtual-subsystem construction are credited.

claims.title: Keep configuration positivity tied to its ensemble in a stable native boson model

quoted_fields.interface: The received source supplies a stable two-site/two-flavor diagonal model with finite uncut grand trace and positive conjugate-field grand weights, but a negative total-number2 field coefficient on a positive-measure set. Separately fixed flavor populations give a different coefficient. Physical canonical partition functions stay positive.
quoted_fields.failure: New stable diagonal source example has a trivial positive occupation representation. It is not sign-problem hardness, phase behavior or simulation advantage; no separate completed review of this new example was acquired. Earlier N1091 accepted attractive/balanced scope is unchanged.
